💥 Box Office पर Ramayana का असली तूफान, 1600 करोड़ के पार पहुंची कमाई!

Ranbir Kapoor, Yash और Sai Pallavi की फिल्म Ramayana ने रिलीज के 16वें दिन एक नया रिकॉर्ड बना दिया है। 🎬

3rd Friday को इस फिल्म ने India में 18.29 करोड़ और Overseas में 8 करोड़ का ग्रॉस कलेक्शन किया। यानी Day 16 पर 26.29 करोड़ कमाकर फिल्म आसानी से 1600 करोड़ क्लब में शामिल हो गई। 🚀

अब तक Ramayana ने India से कुल 1081.39 करोड़ और Overseas से 531.15 करोड़ बटोरे हैं, जिससे इसका total worldwide collection 1612.54 करोड़ ग्रॉस हो गया है।

Dangal के बाद 1600 करोड़ का आंकड़ा छूने वाली यह दूसरी non-sequel भारतीय फिल्म बन चुकी है। साथ ही, यह ओवरऑल दुनिया भर में 5th highest-grossing Indian film बन गई है।

Nitesh Tiwari के डायरेक्शन में बनी इस फिल्म का म्यूजिक AR Rahman और Hans Zimmer ने दिया है।

क्या आपको लगता है कि Ramayana बॉक्स ऑफिस के सारे पुराने रिकॉर्ड्स तोड़ देगी? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय दीजिए! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana Worldwide Box Office Day 16: Becomes Only 2nd Non-Sequel Indian Film To Enter The 1600 Crore Club!
ctx.summary:
Ramayana added another 25 crore+ globally on its third Friday, day 16, making a smashing entry into the 1600 crore club. 
 The post  Ramayana Worldwide Box Office Day 16: Becomes Only 2nd Non-Sequel Indian Film To Enter The 1600 Crore Club!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, entered the third week by dropping below the 30 crore mark for the first time globally. Despite a considerable drop on the third Friday, the magnum opus comfortably entered the 1600 crore club at the worldwide box office. With this, it has become the second non-sequel Indian film to hit the 1600 crore milestone. Keep reading for a detailed report of day 16!
The Bollywood magnum opus grossed 18.29 crore in India on its third Friday, while internationally, it grossed an estimated 8 crore . Overall, it grossed 26.29 crore globally on day 16, down 29.44% from day 15’s 37.26 crore . In total, the film has grossed 1081.39 crore in India and 531.15 crore overseas. Combining both, the worldwide box office collection stands at 1612.54 crore gross.
By entering the 1600 crore club worldwide in 16 days, Ramayana has become the second non-sequel Indian film to achieve the feat after Dangal. Overall, it has become the fifth Indian film to reach the 1600 crore mark. It is also currently the fifth-highest-grossing Indian film globally.
Ramayana is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and is produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash under the banner of Prime Focus Studios, Monster Mind Creations, and DNEG. It stars Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash, Ravi Dubey, Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Indira Krishnan, Rakul Preet Singh, Sonal Jha, Vivek Oberoi, and others. The music is composed by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer.
